## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text is the structural-outline (*kē wén* 科文) by [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì for his own *[Zhù fǎ jiè guānmén 註法界觀門](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0101)* (T1884) — the navigational map for the parent annotated text of the *Fǎ jiè guānmén*. As with all *kē wén* works, the function is pedagogical and navigational: providing the hierarchical heading-table of the parent commentary.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (820 – 841) reflects [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) Zōngmì's mature scholarly activity at the Cǎotángsì on Mt. Guīfēng. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1007).
